description: This line plot illustrates the memory consumption in gigabytes (GB) for five different video understanding models—VideoLLaMB-R, PLLaVA, LLaVA-NeXT, and VideoLLaVA—as a function of the number of video frames processed, ranging from 0 to 1000 frames on a linear x-axis. The y-axis, labeled “Memory (GB)”, spans from 0 to 400 GB and is also linearly scaled. The plot displays five distinct lines: VideoLLaMB-R is represented by a gold line with circle markers; PLLaVA by a green line with circle markers; LLaVA-NeXT by a cyan line with circle markers; and VideoLLaVA by a magenta line with circle markers. The VideoLLaMB-R model shows a nearly flat memory usage, starting at approximately 15 GB and rising slightly to about 35 GB by 1000 frames. PLLaVA begins at around 15 GB and increases gradually to about 75 GB. LLaVA-NeXT starts at approximately 15 GB and rises steadily to about 145 GB. In contrast, VideoLLaVA begins at approximately 15 GB and exhibits a steep, exponential-like increase, reaching over 400 GB by 300 frames, after which it continues to rise sharply beyond that point. The legend in the top-left corner identifies each model and its corresponding line style and color.
